node_definition.done_when: reckon.crew.promotion._evaluate_suite_delta returns a suite_delta with status unchanged, the suite_command, added_failure_ids [] and a reason, instead of raising SuiteDeltaError for missing baseline_suite/after_suite, when the run changed nothing: its fresh manifest's changed_paths is empty, it names no commit other than the record's base_sha, and, when the run's worktree still exists, the worktree HEAD equals base_sha with no tracked modification. A run whose worktree head moved past base_sha, or whose manifest names a changed path or a commit past base_sha, is refused exactly as before. reckon/ledger.py counts the unchanged status beside clean, refused and waived in its suite-delta tally. A new tests/test_an_unchanged_run_needs_no_suite_pair.py covers a decline-only run with a suite_command and no suite fields (promotes, suite_delta status unchanged), a run with one commit past base and no suite fields (still refused with missing baseline_suite, after_suite), and a run whose manifest is empty but whose worktree head moved (still refused). Only the named test files are run, with no call reaching SLURM, each log ending with an EXIT= line; the coordinator runs the wider population at merge. Before status complete, delete every directory you created under /tmp, print what you delete, and list it in artifacts.
node_definition.goal: make an armed promotion accept a run that changed nothing without a baseline and after suite pair
